verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a configurable risk-score equation and lets you create multiple screening configurations and pick one per customer at screening time. That gives some configurable, risk-oriented logic, but nothing confirms it is done in a no-code UI rather than through API calls. missing for 10: no-code workflow builder with conditional steps, risk-based routing between verification paths, country-specific requirement rules, template changes without an engineering deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
